gen-fs-oswald-gf-eczar: Eczar reads in a literary, traditional voice, a text serif with a plain build that never fusses over the line. Oswald hits hard with tight, strong rows; Eczar does the quiet literary work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-faustina: Oswald packs its confident, strong letters into tightly knit rows that look ready to march. Faustina, a text serif, loosens things with an open-jawed c and bowls that thin gracefully.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-halant: Tight and tough, Oswald keeps a low lowercase and packs its rows close. Halant lifts a towering lowercase with outward-pointing terminals, so low heading and tall text meet in the middle.
